title: Pope Leo XIV publishes AI encyclical alongside Anthropic's Chris Olah
summary: The Vatican published Magnifica Humanitas, calling for robust AI regulation, opposing AI in warfare and defending workers and human dignity; Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah appeared with the Pope.
reason: Global moral authority calls to slow and regulate AI; broad public-opinion signal.

title: UK and Australia sign AI security MoUs
summary: The UK AI Security Institute and Australia's AI Safety Institute signed a memorandum on AI security risks, alongside a broader bilateral MoU on safe AI.
